recognize_zh: A 圖冠狀 CT 見巨大前縱膈腔腫塊合併肋膜及心包膜積液；B 圖母細胞核質比高、染色質細緻、有明顯核仁，細胞質淡藍無顆粒並拉出手鏡狀（hand-mirror）突起；C 圖流式中紅色母細胞 cyCD3 強陽、表面 CD3 弱、CD7 強陽、CD45 弱，年輕男性加上縱膈腫塊，符合 T 淋巴母細胞白血病／淋巴瘤。
features: Panel A (coronal CT): bulky anterior mediastinal mass with bilateral pleural effusions and pericardial effusion
Panel B (smear): large blasts with high N:C ratio, round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin and prominent nucleoli
Blast cytoplasm scant to moderate, mildly basophilic and agranular, drawn into elongated hand-mirror (uropod) projections
Panel C (flow): blast population (red) CD45 dim with low side scatter and partial CD34 expression
Blasts show bright cytoplasmic CD3 with dim/partial surface CD3 and bright CD7, supporting T-lineage
describe_en: Coronal chest CT demonstrates a bulky anterior mediastinal mass with bilateral pleural and pericardial effusions. The smear shows large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and prominent nucleoli, and mildly basophilic agranular cytoplasm forming hand-mirror projections, without Auer rods or vacuoles. Flow cytometry reveals a dominant CD45-dim, low side-scatter blast population with partial CD34, bright cytoplasmic CD3, dim surface CD3 and bright CD7 expression. The combination of mediastinal mass, lymphoblastic morphology and T-lineage precursor phenotype is consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts may show granules or Auer rods and express MPO, CD13/CD33/CD117, whereas these blasts are MPO-negative and cytoplasmic CD3 bright.
B-ALL blasts look identical but express CD19, CD79a and PAX5 and lack cytoplasmic CD3, and rarely present with a bulky mediastinal mass.

Thymic T cells are TdT+/CD1a+ but show a normal maturational continuum (CD4/CD8 double-positive to single-positive) with cytokeratin-positive epithelium, unlike this monomorphic CD4−/CD8− blast population in marrow and blood.
ETP-ALL lacks CD1a and CD8, has weak CD5 and expresses stem/myeloid markers (CD117, CD13, CD33, HLA-DR), whereas these blasts are CD5+, CD1a+ and myeloid-negative.
